cohort: 351 obstetric patients undergoing Lower Segment Caesarean Sections at Civil Hospital, Ahmedabad.
finding: The overall surgical site infection rate in Lower Segment Caesarean Sections was 5.12%, with prolonged postoperative hospitalization, emergency procedures, and multidrug-resistant E. coli and Staphylococcus aureus identified as key contributors.
mod_finding: General anesthesia was associated with a higher infection rate (16.6%) compared to spinal anesthesia (4.92%, p<0.0001) for lower segment Caesarean sections.
